Three Lucky Blocks Every 5 Minutes is a lightweight Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.19.2 that automatically gives every player 3 Lucky Blocks every 5 minutes of real gameplay time.

This mod is perfect for servers, challenges, minigames, or chaotic survival worlds.

⭐ Features

Automatically gives each player 3 Lucky Blocks every 5 minutes

Fully server‑side — players don’t need to install anything

Works with any Lucky Block mod that registers the item as lucky:lucky_block

No commands required

No configuration needed

Lightweight and optimized for multiplayer


🎮 How It Affects Gameplay

Players will constantly receive new Lucky Blocks, creating:

More chaos

More fun

More random events

Faster progression

Endless surprises

Perfect for streamers, SMPs, and challenge maps.


📦 Requirements

Fabric Loader 0.14.9+

Fabric API

Minecraft 1.19.2
